submission.justification: Crystal-K2 gives the best simulated 662 keV resolution, 2.726% FWHM at 4.5 cm. Its thickness scan is a shallow optimum around 4.5 cm. K1 reaches 4.47% and K3 reaches 8.7%. No intrinsic radioactivity data exists for any candidate, so low-background suitability of K2 is unverified. Intrinsic activity (for example from La-138 or Lu-176 type contamination) should be checked before procurement.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K2 at 4.5 cm gives 2.726% FWHM, the lowest of all simulated options. Best K1 is 4.466% and best K3 is 8.692%.
